messages:
kelly: Heads-up — multiple reports of console graphs failing to load across accounts. Users see spinners and 5xx from analytics API. Screenshot: https://redwood.app/s/xyz (redacted).

infra-bot: ALERT: analytics-api 5xx spike detected (11m avg error rate 6%) service=analytics-api env=prod

sam: On it. Do we have any request ids from the browser devtools or API logs to trace?

kelly: Pasted one from a user session: `req_id=aa7f3b9f` header `x-request-id=aa7f3b9f`. Response body: `{"error":"internal_server_error","reason":"clickhouse timeout"}`. From devtools:
```
curl 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/analytics/query' \n  -H 'authorization: Bearer ****' \n  -d '{"range":"30d","panels":[...],"group_by":"host"}'
```

jordan: ClickHouse timeouts fit the pattern. We had a short spike in query latency at ~13:12 UTC. Any recent changes to analytics-query-service or materialized view refreshes?

mike: No deploys on the analytics service from platform last hour. But I do see a rise in large-range dashboard queries (30d+ with group_by across tenants) — likely fanout to many shards.

sam: Tailing logs now. Confirmed `ReadTimeout` from ClickHouse pool for several queries matching `req_id=aa7f3b9f` and similar. Repro: open console, set time range to 30d, toggle grouping, refresh -> triggers heavy multi-shard query. Can reproduce locally against staging.

kelly: Repro steps verified on staging :white_check_mark:.

sam: Quick mitigation: bump analytics query timeout to 20s on a canary (2 hosts) to see if we avoid 5xx. Also enabling light rate-limit on console->analytics gateway for dashboard requests issuing >10 subqueries.

infra-bot: DEPLOYMENT: analytics-api - timeout-bump by sam @ 2026-03-17T13:35:00Z (canary)

mike: Customer-facing workaround: ask users to narrow the time window (7d works), or disable grouping/aggregation, or use pre-aggregated report. I can draft a short support note.

teresa: (from affected customer) Thanks — switching to 7d made the panels render again. Is there an ETA for a permanent fix?

sam: If canary looks stable (monitoring for 15-30m), we can roll to the fleet within ~30m. Longer-term: follow-up with storage/query team to add materialized views + preferential routing to reduce cross-shard fanout.

jordan: Also proposing: server-side partial-response fallback — return available tiles with a warning when some shards time out, so the console doesn't block the whole dashboard.

kelly: I'll send an update to the affected customers right now with the workaround and expected timeline. Creating internal tracker: ENG-RUNTIME-12345 and escalating to incidents channel.

alyssa: Thanks team. Keep me updated in this thread and ping if roll needs ops assistance. :thumbsup:
